turnover_financial.text: op draagkracht van derden Wanneer een inschrijver beroep doet op de draagkracht van andere entiteiten en die draagkracht bepalend is voor zijn selectie, vermeldt hij verplicht voor welk gedeelte van de opdracht hij een beroep doet op die draagkracht. Hij deelt tevens de (onvoorwaar delijke) verbintenis mee van die derde of van die derden dat zij hun middelen ter beschikking zullen stellen. De betrokken entiteit mag zich niet in een uitsluitingssituatie bevinden en dient te voldoen aan het selectiecriterium dat betrekking heeft op de draagkracht waarop de inschrijver beroep doet. Indien de inschrijver zich beroept op de economische en financiële draagkracht van een andere entiteit, kan de aanbestedende overheid vragen dat deze laatste zich hoofdelijk verbindt tot uitvoering van de opdracht en vragen het schriftelijk bewijs van een hoofdelijke verbintenis tot uitvoering van de opdracht voor te leggen. Indien de inschrijver zich beroept op de studie-en beroepskwalificaties of de relevante beroepservaring van een andere entiteit, is hij verplicht daadwerkelijk beroep te doen op deze entiteit voor wat betreft de uitvoering van de opdracht. De inzet van and ere onderaannemers is onderworpen aan de voorafgaande toestemming van de aanbestedende overheid. 8.2. Regelmatigheid van de offertes D

deliverables_scope.text: ydrologic engineering and water resources planning and management. In addition to supporting USACE along with Division and District Offices, HEC provides technical support to the Corps overseas. Additionally, HEC provides services to other Federal, state, local and international agencies engaged in these technical areas. The primary way HEC accomplishes this mission is by developing state-of-the-art software tools bringing them to state-of-the practice that are reliably used by water resources engineers and planners. Since its inception in 1964, HEC has been developing and integrating software tools that support the water resources computing requirements for Corps field offices, headquarters, laboratories, and other Federal, state, and international agencies. The CWMS is the Army Information System (AIS) that supports and enhances the decision-making process for the USACE water management mission. USACE is responsible for round-the-clock monitoring and operation of approximately 600 reservoir, lock and dam, and other water control projects. This responsibility also expands, during flood control operations, to approximately 120 additional Section 7 (Non-USACE) projects. Section 7 dams are non-USACE-owned dams for which the USACE prescribes regulations for flood control or navigation operatio

As such, HEC believes it is most appropriate to focus our updated access control efforts on CDA, the API through which data will be accessed. Objective 2: Health Topic Collaboration The contractor will collaborate with the NIPHC team to identify health topics and health education materials on a weekly basis. sla_onsite.text: 3350 La Jolla Village Dr. San Diego, CA 92161 Period of Performance: 9/26/2026 to 9/25/2027 Contract Type: Firm Fixed Price Background and Scope: Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation Services, including the Experiential and Recreation Therapy program, requires contractor support to provide LEGO Serious Play workshops as part of its therapeutic and experiential rehabilitation programming. The workshops offer structured, hands-on model building activities designed to support patient communication, engagement, insight, and rehabilitation goals. The contractor will deliver four onsite workshops, coordinate planning sessions with PMRS and ERT staff, provide all necessary LEGO materials and facilitation tools, guide participants through the LEGO Serious Play methodology, collect and summarize participant feedback, and conduct follow up discussions with program stakeholders to review outcomes and identify future needs. These services will help expand creative therapeutic options available to Veterans receiving care at the VA San Diego Healthcare System and support whole health, communication, and experiential therapy objectives within the PMRS and ERT programs. The Contractor shall provide LSP workshops in accordance with VA

hrough the LEGO Serious Play methodology, collect and summarize participant feedback, and conduct follow up discussions with program stakeholders to review outcomes and identify future needs. These services will help expand creative therapeutic options available to Veterans receiving care at the VA San Diego Healthcare System and support whole health, communication, and experiential therapy objectives within the PMRS and ERT programs. The Contractor shall provide LSP workshops in accordance with VA provider request and program scheduling requirements. The services will include: • Four in-person LEGO Serious Play 3–4 hour workshops delivered onsite. • Practitioner- and participant-facing facilitation for up to 10 participants per workshop. • Two planning meetings (30–60 minutes each) per workshop. • All required LEGO Starter Kits, bricks, facilitator tools, and materials. Includes 10 LSP starter kits for the site to retain after workshop completion. • Digital summary including photos, themes, insights, and outcomes per workshop. • Anonymous participant feedback survey and compiled results per workshop. • Post-workshop follow-up meeting with PMRS/ERT stakeholders. • Optional onboarding materials, participant pre-work, and post-intervention debrief per workshop. deliverables_scope.text: cial Notice DESCRIPTION The Bureau of Reclamation Acquisition Management Division hereby provides notice of its intent to award a single source contract to Rochester Software Associates (RSA) of Rochester, NY. The Bureau of Reclamation intends to negotiate a sole source contract with Rochester Software Associates for professional services to integrate existing internally hosted government perpetual licensed web-to-print application to communicate to outside third-party vendor printing devices. The contractor shall provide all the required integration services and will include additional site license and maintenance support for all requirements issued under the contract. Reclamation utilizes Rochester Software Associates (RSA) WebCRD web-to-print web-based application hosted by the Government on its Intranet to place and submit printing related orders. WebCRD is a web-based print job submission software that allows users to submit printing or reproduction requests via a browser connection. The job status can be tracked by the user. The product provides customizable reports for summarizing device utilization and printing costs. The product also provides for tab creation and the build a job; adding multiple files and arranging them; as well as combining them with markers

ts. The product also provides for tab creation and the build a job; adding multiple files and arranging them; as well as combining them with markers for potential tab placement at the markers. The following current modules implemented with the WebCRD include: Dynamics, Book Assembly, AutoStock. THIS NOTICE OF INTENT IS NOT A REQUEST FOR COMPETITIVE QUOTES. The determination not to compete this proposed purchase order base and four option years was made pursuant to the Federal Acquisition Regulation, Revolutionary FAR Overhall (RFO) FAR Part 12.102, only one responsible source and no other supplies or services will satisfy agency requirements. The Government anticipates award on or around September 17, 2026. A determination not to compete this requirement, based upon responses to this notice, is solely within the discretion of the Government. The Bureau of Reclamation will not be responsible for any costs incurred by interested parties in responding. turnover_financial.text: op draagkracht van derden Wanneer een inschrijver beroep doet op de draagkracht van andere entiteiten en die draagkracht bepalend is voor zijn selectie, vermeldt hij verplicht voor welk gedeelte van de opdracht hij een beroep doet op die draagkracht. Hij deelt tevens de (onvoorwaar delijke) verbintenis mee van die derde of van die derden dat zij hun middelen ter beschikking zullen stellen. De betrokken entiteit mag zich niet in een uitsluitingssituatie bevinden en dient te voldoen aan het selectiecriterium dat betrekking heeft op de draagkracht waarop de inschrijver beroep doet. Indien de inschrijver zich beroept op de economische en financiële draagkracht van een andere entiteit, kan de aanbestedende overheid vragen dat deze laatste zich hoofdelijk verbindt tot uitvoering van de opdracht en vragen het schriftelijk bewijs van een hoofdelijke verbintenis tot uitvoering van de opdracht voor te leggen. Indien de inschrijver zich beroept op de studie-en beroepskwalificaties of de relevante beroepservaring van een andere entiteit, is hij verplicht daadwerkelijk beroep te doen op deze entiteit voor wat betreft de uitvoering van de opdracht. De inzet van and ere onderaannemers is onderworpen aan de voorafgaande toestemming van de aanbestedende overheid. 8.2. Regelmatigheid van de offertes D

deliverables_scope.text: ydrologic engineering and water resources planning and management. In addition to supporting USACE along with Division and District Offices, HEC provides technical support to the Corps overseas. Additionally, HEC provides services to other Federal, state, local and international agencies engaged in these technical areas. The primary way HEC accomplishes this mission is by developing state-of-the-art software tools bringing them to state-of-the practice that are reliably used by water resources engineers and planners. Since its inception in 1964, HEC has been developing and integrating software tools that support the water resources computing requirements for Corps field offices, headquarters, laboratories, and other Federal, state, and international agencies. The CWMS is the Army Information System (AIS) that supports and enhances the decision-making process for the USACE water management mission. USACE is responsible for round-the-clock monitoring and operation of approximately 600 reservoir, lock and dam, and other water control projects. This responsibility also expands, during flood control operations, to approximately 120 additional Section 7 (Non-USACE) projects. Section 7 dams are non-USACE-owned dams for which the USACE prescribes regulations for flood control or navigation operatio

This is a new requirement and IHS NIPHC is looking for a capable, experienced contractor. 1.3 Scope The NIPHC seeks a contractor to work in close collaboration with all departments on the development and dissemination of communication products that support public health outreach efforts. This partnership will focus on creating high-quality health education materials on topics including, but not limited to: Emerging health topics Immunizations and vaccine-preventable diseases Infectious and chronic diseases Environmental, maternal, and behavioral health Injury/violence prevention, nutrition, and substance abuse 2.0 GENERAL REQUIREMENTS & OBJECTIVES The Contractor shall provide services to expand the availability of accessible, culturally relevant health information. Objective 1: Kick-off Meeting The contractor will meet with the Contracting Officer’s Representative (COR) and IHS officials within five (5) days of the contract award to review the PWS, discuss timelines and deliverables, and begin initial planning. sla_onsite.text: 3350 La Jolla Village Dr. San Diego, CA 92161 Period of Performance: 9/26/2026 to 9/25/2027 Contract Type: Firm Fixed Price Background and Scope: Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation Services, including the Experiential and Recreation Therapy program, requires contractor support to provide LEGO Serious Play workshops as part of its therapeutic and experiential rehabilitation programming. The workshops offer structured, hands-on model building activities designed to support patient communication, engagement, insight, and rehabilitation goals. The contractor will deliver four onsite workshops, coordinate planning sessions with PMRS and ERT staff, provide all necessary LEGO materials and facilitation tools, guide participants through the LEGO Serious Play methodology, collect and summarize participant feedback, and conduct follow up discussions with program stakeholders to review outcomes and identify future needs. These services will help expand creative therapeutic options available to Veterans receiving care at the VA San Diego Healthcare System and support whole health, communication, and experiential therapy objectives within the PMRS and ERT programs. The Contractor shall provide LSP workshops in accordance with VA

hrough the LEGO Serious Play methodology, collect and summarize participant feedback, and conduct follow up discussions with program stakeholders to review outcomes and identify future needs. These services will help expand creative therapeutic options available to Veterans receiving care at the VA San Diego Healthcare System and support whole health, communication, and experiential therapy objectives within the PMRS and ERT programs. The Contractor shall provide LSP workshops in accordance with VA provider request and program scheduling requirements. The services will include: • Four in-person LEGO Serious Play 3–4 hour workshops delivered onsite. • Practitioner- and participant-facing facilitation for up to 10 participants per workshop. • Two planning meetings (30–60 minutes each) per workshop. • All required LEGO Starter Kits, bricks, facilitator tools, and materials. Includes 10 LSP starter kits for the site to retain after workshop completion. • Digital summary including photos, themes, insights, and outcomes per workshop. • Anonymous participant feedback survey and compiled results per workshop. • Post-workshop follow-up meeting with PMRS/ERT stakeholders. • Optional onboarding materials, participant pre-work, and post-intervention debrief per workshop. In addition to the above

deliverables_scope.text: cial Notice DESCRIPTION The Bureau of Reclamation Acquisition Management Division hereby provides notice of its intent to award a single source contract to Rochester Software Associates (RSA) of Rochester, NY. The Bureau of Reclamation intends to negotiate a sole source contract with Rochester Software Associates for professional services to integrate existing internally hosted government perpetual licensed web-to-print application to communicate to outside third-party vendor printing devices. The contractor shall provide all the required integration services and will include additional site license and maintenance support for all requirements issued under the contract. Reclamation utilizes Rochester Software Associates (RSA) WebCRD web-to-print web-based application hosted by the Government on its Intranet to place and submit printing related orders. WebCRD is a web-based print job submission software that allows users to submit printing or reproduction requests via a browser connection. The job status can be tracked by the user. The product provides customizable reports for summarizing device utilization and printing costs. The product also provides for tab creation and the build a job; adding multiple files and arranging them; as well as combining them with markers

ts. The product also provides for tab creation and the build a job; adding multiple files and arranging them; as well as combining them with markers for potential tab placement at the markers. The following current modules implemented with the WebCRD include: Dynamics, Book Assembly, AutoStock. THIS NOTICE OF INTENT IS NOT A REQUEST FOR COMPETITIVE QUOTES. The determination not to compete this proposed purchase order base and four option years was made pursuant to the Federal Acquisition Regulation, Revolutionary FAR Overhall (RFO) FAR Part 12.102, only one responsible source and no other supplies or services will satisfy agency requirements. The Government anticipates award on or around September 17, 2026. A determination not to compete this requirement, based upon responses to this notice, is solely within the discretion of the Government.
